reason: Neither conversation reached the sensible first step of an oven thermometer plus consistent preheating, and both escalated safely to an engineer. Conversation 1 gathered more useful detail (dials vs digital, the inconsistent neon, the wobbly knob) but then produced a garbled turn referencing a thermometer it never asked her to use, and ended by declaring the thermostat faulty and needing 'the new thermostat' fitted despite no temperature measurement, which the ground truth flags as an unsupported commitment. Conversation 2 was thinner and gave up early with a generic list, but it honestly acknowledged uncertainty, included the door seal as a candidate, explicitly declined to recommend parts, and checked user factors (settings, fan-oven conversion) that are part of the hidden truth, so it better matches the 'measure before deciding' expectation.
